# Vibe Coding Protocols — Full LLM Reference

## What is VCP

VCP is a foundation and trust layer for AI-assisted product delivery.
It helps teams build from idea to production without losing control.

## Current version and methodology

- Repository package: `v0.6.1`
- Web methodology: `v1.4`
- Canonical repository: `https://github.com/Gudvin82/vibe-coding-protocols`

## Core evaluation path

Do not evaluate VCP from `README.md` alone.
Start with:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `AI_EVALUATION_GUIDE.md`
- `AI_INTAKE.md`
- `START_HERE.md`
- `.vcp/index.json`
- `.vcp/cards/`
- `docs/product-delivery-lifecycle.md`
- `docs/flagship-workflows.md`

Then run:
- `python3 -m vcp_cli doctor`
- `python3 -m vcp_cli score --json`
- `python3 -m vcp_cli review-diff --json`
- `python3 -m vcp_cli manifest validate`
- `python3 -m vcp_cli benchmark run`

## Flagship workflows

1. Build an AI-assisted product from idea.
2. Harden an AI-generated MVP.
3. Review ongoing AI-driven changes before merge.

## Trust surfaces

- `docs/review-diff.md`
- `docs/score-badge.md`
- `docs/github-action.md`
- `docs/anti-patterns.md`
- `docs/public-proof-roadmap.md`
- `ADOPTERS.md`
- `case-studies/README.md`

## Platform coverage note

VCP is documented for 25+ AI coding tools and workflows.
That does not mean 25+ official plugins.
See `docs/platforms/README.md` for status taxonomy and limitations.

## Spec-first bridge

Spec-first tools help define what to build.
VCP helps govern how AI-assisted changes move safely toward merge and production.
See `docs/integrations/spec-kit-bridge.md`.

## What VCP is not

- not a scanner;
- not a compliance certification;
- not a guarantee of production safety;
- not a guarantee of AI citation, indexing, or ranking;
- not an official plugin suite unless explicitly stated.
